intent: Accept the genuine external Fresh-Agent Continuity Drill v3 sequence-120 result and extend existing continuity/capability governance with a universal plain-language L3/L4 user-decision and durable worker-escalation handoff protocol, without changing Architecture Baseline v1 semantics.
rationale_summary: Seq120 genuine external Fresh-Agent v3 tested main@29c506ad with canonical cue digests, bounded reads, stable subject HEAD and one report-only commit; maintainer review accepts it as PASS. The user additionally requires every Agent to stop potential L3/L4 implementation and explain the decision in plain language. Existing continuity and capability-governance owners are sufficient, so this extends them rather than creating a new governance owner.
